svg.title: How a KPI is measured: from the key press to the first frame where the screen is loaded, in one image
svg.text: A KPI is the time you wait: from the key press to the right screen.
Shown is not loaded: we also time when the last grey box is filled.
The clock starts when the key goes out
Many apps first draw grey boxes, then fill them
Loaded means no grey box is left and nothing new is drawn for 2 seconds.
A real measurement from our platform
KPI 1.16 s ± 0.2 s, fully loaded 0.2 s later.
No frame passes? Fully Loaded stays empty: a finding, not a pass.
